review_response_tasks.stem: Why will the speakers avoid the footpath tonight?
options: It is closed for building work.
It is much longer than the main road.
Part of it will be unlit.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 末段无灯且回程天黑；A无封路，B更短。

review_response_tasks.stem: When might they try the footpath?
review_response_tasks.rationale: 末句周六早去市场时尝试；B/C与决定冲突。

review_response_tasks.stem: What pattern does the woman notice?
options: Complaints came mainly from behind a pillar.
All seating areas reported the same problem.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 多数抱怨者在柱后，前排清楚；A/C不符。

review_response_tasks.stem: Why might increasing the volume be unsuitable?
options: It could make sound uncomfortable near the front.
The speakers have no volume controls.
The evening show has been cancelled.
review_response_tasks.rationale: M据前排已清楚推音量更大会不适；B/C无。

review_response_tasks.stem: What does the woman suggest doing?
options: Waiting until the audience is seated.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 先测一个位置并留恢复时间；A/B相反。

review_response_tasks.stem: Why is an indoor café lunch unsuitable for the whole group?
options: The café opens only in the evening.
There are fewer indoor seats than cyclists.
The café does not serve any food.

review_response_tasks.stem: What arrangement does the man propose?
options: Collect ordered lunches and eat farther along.
Cancel the trip unless everyone buys lunch.
Leave half the cyclists at the starting point.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 可预订午餐去有顶野餐点；B可自带，C非方案。

review_response_tasks.stem: What should cyclists do before setting off?
options: Return the booking forms to the café.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 野餐点无饮水龙头，需出发前灌水；A/B无要求。

review_response_tasks.stem: Why is the original plan being reconsidered?
What is the woman's view of Lena using a script?
options: It must be hidden from the audience.
It is acceptable with an honest explanation.
It proves the performance must be cancelled.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 支持公开说明、可持稿减压；A/C相反。

review_response_tasks.stem: What will rehearsals focus on particularly?
options: A scene with important movement timing.

review_response_tasks.stem: Why should the ticket desk be informed?
options: So people know the change before deciding to attend.
So the replacement actor can sell every ticket.
So all seats can be made free immediately.

review_response_tasks.stem: Why were two speaking tasks used?
options: To test which volunteers read fastest.
To compare common words and hear less scripted speech.
To make every person tell the same memory.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 同读便比较，自述显自然特征；A速度非目标，C记忆各自。

review_response_tasks.stem: What limitation of the collection is acknowledged?
options: Some parts of the community may be underrepresented.
No volunteers grew up in the district.
Every speaker used exactly the same accent.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 一中心招募可能漏常不到者；B/C未支持。

review_response_tasks.stem: What should visitors do before seeking further use of a recording?
options: Upload a copy to prove their interest.
Treat exhibition access as unrestricted permission.
Discuss access with the project team.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 授权展览不等任意上传，进一步使用先找团队；A/B相反。
